patch_description:
This implementation replaces the original per-layer Python packing loops with a batched capped-LPT scheduler. It processes all MoE layers simultaneously while preserving exact slot capacities: heavy groups or replicas are considered first and assigned to the currently least-loaded eligible destination.

The design keeps hierarchical locality when group-to-node partitioning is possible, but improves placement efficiency through vectorized tensor updates rather than nested Python list/min operations. Replica creation uses batched marginal load reduction: each additional replica is assigned to the logical expert with the highest current per-replica pressure. The resulting replicas are then packed across GPUs with the same capacity-aware scheduler, improving GPU balance without violating per-GPU physical-expert counts.
